lists.name: This album is the BEST in its GENRE @Frenchblues

podcast.body: Recorded in Paris, this album was praised by Vince Aletti as "one of the best to emerge from the new discotech scene," far exceeding its title single. Dibango and his band of expatriates from formerly French West Africa crafted a "heady Afro jazz blend using horns and electric guitars, but in an utterly African way," creating a sound perfectly suited for "a subtropical evening in the jungle of the cities." "Vince Letty wrote of the album Soul Macosa in 1973, quote, far from being a package of waste filler cushioning the title single. It is one of the best to emerge from the new disco tech scene recorded in Paris, Manu DuBango and his group of ex-patriots from formerly French West Africa put together a heady Afro jazz blend using horns and electric guitars, but in an utterly African way."
